items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Jack comes along one day and says, 'Look, this is fine,' but he says, 'You know how the Rhapsody in Blue is?' ... I'd like him to write a slow theme ... Well, that hit Bix fine, in no time at all, he came up with the theme that he wanted.

ctx.x: I remember seeing a picture of him and he seemed like a very handsome guy, too, in fact, at the time that I saw the picture, you know, maybe 15 years ago or so, I drew a parallel with Stan Getz. He reminded me of Getz in this picture. I don't know what he looked like in real life.
I remember at the time -- what's that early tenor saxophone player Jack -- that used to play around New York.
